svg.aria-label: Left: the squares of a missing south wing with W and S on their own axes, at v = 0.15, s = 0.35, d = 0.75, in the smallest disk that allows these separations (radius 1.717); the separating lines of the stress with the weights 1.82, 1.59, 1.09, 1 and its forces. Right: the quadrilateral 0 <= v <= s <= 2/3, v + s <= 24/25 at d = 11/14, shaded by the profile, with the lower bounds of Table D.10 at its vertices
